own_solution.law: Hydrostatics (Pascal): p_small = p_large + rho g h; piston equilibrium F + p0 A_s = p_small A_s, Mg + p0 A_L = p_large A_L; F = A_s (Mg/A_L + rho g h)

notes: Mg/A_L = 11760/0.08 = 147000 Pa; rho g h = 850*9.8*1.5 = 12495 Pa; F = 0.002*159495 = 318.99 N. With 1760 kg: 215600 + 12495 = 228095 Pa, F = 456.19 N. Atmospheric pressure acts on both outer faces and cancels. Variants: T4EF7/T3BBA both 94 kPa; T4338/T1A9B/TED46/T6417 all 560 kg; TC4F6/TF1DC both 'small load'. Consistent. T6417 (past tense, 'before the force was applied') is R like T4338.
